segments.text: I'd like us to make headway on the trip for the two seventh-grade classes to the Combe Noire centre, three days in December. We're taking fifty-two pupils and six chaperones, and transport and paperwork still need sorting out.
For transport, I suggest the train to Morez. It's a hundred and forty euros less than the coach.
With fifty-two pupils and two connections, I really don't like the train idea. We could lose someone at Bourg-en-Bresse station. I'd rather have a chartered coach, door to door.
I'm with Farida on this. Yannick, are you OK with ruling out the train?
Yes, safety first. Let's go with the coach.
Chartered coach it is, there and back. Yannick, can you book it with our usual company?
No problem. I'll call the company tomorrow and lock in the date.
For cancellation insurance, I'll ask two insurers for quotes and pass them on to you.
Thanks. The parental consent forms: I'll hand them out to the pupils on Monday and collect them signed before November 20.
On the budget, the trip comes to a hundred and eighty euros per pupil. Some families won't be able to keep up.
For that, we go through Mrs Garnier, the bursar: she's the one who will put together the subsidy application to the county council.
There's also the information evening for parents. Yesterday, in the staff room, Yannick said to me: “I'll take the parents' meeting, I know all the families.”
That was a joke on my way out of a class council, I'm not taking that meeting. Let's talk about the activities instead.
For the peat bog workshop, I could possibly put together a booklet for the pupils, provided my class councils are wrapped up in time.
That would be nice. We also need the list of pupils with allergies or medication, the centre is asking for it.
I'll forward you that list tonight, I have it in my locker.
For activities, the centre offers snowshoe hiking and a visit to the cheese dairy. Kayaking is closed in December.
Forget what I said about cancellation insurance: I won't be asking for quotes after all. The centre already includes it in its package.
For the snowshoes, the centre provides all the equipment, there's nothing to buy.
Perfect. Let's meet again after the class councils to finalize the programme.
